desc: Derive and validate the exact greedy feasibility check for a target minimum score, including visit counts and movement costs.
Prove that the greedy left-to-right strategy minimizes moves for each fixed target.
Handle boundary cases: the first position, the last position, \(m<n\), and unreachable targets.
Determine safe binary-search bounds and integer arithmetic requirements.
Implement `Solution.maxScore` with \(O(n\log V)\) time and \(O(1)\) auxiliary space.
